title: Historic Atlas — One origin, clear routes
features: Dark blueprint ingress explainer with interactive path resolver, environment-dependent actuator routing, trusted-hop forwarded-header and request-ID simulation, sanitized JSON access-log specimen and upstream diagram.
limits: Local policy visualization only, not a running proxy or security test. Keycloak endpoint allowlist belongs to the separate authentication specification. No containers, TLS, DNS resolution, telemetry or network requests run.
